verdict.rationale: Bun is explicitly designed as an npm-compatible package manager, installing directly from the npm registry (the largest JS package ecosystem) with lockfile migration from npm/yarn/pnpm, global installs, bunx for one-off execution, and workspace/monorepo support, all documented extensively. Community reports corroborate real-world usage of `bun install` against npm packages, with some install reliability bugs and edge-case runtime incompatibilities (unrelated to registry breadth) noted as caveats. Missing for 10: independent benchmark of registry breadth/failure-rate across large package sets, and resolution of noted install crash bugs.
